user_requested_changes: Remove the unassigned-transactions option from the Home account selector, while safely resetting an old saved unassigned display preference to All accounts without discarding historical records.
Allow the user to choose a date in the verified internal transfer form, while preserving verified source/destination selection and stable duplicate-protected transfer intent.
Require a real verified financial account before confirming a recurring due or a cash-financed savings goal due; never inherit the selected Home account.

Repair the finance write refusal after selecting Paid on a recurring due by narrowing the fresh SQLCipher captured delta to the single new posting and the related postponed metadata, without weakening unrelated finance-data guards.
Maintain an explicit accurate 32-item implementation tracker showing complete, partial, unverified, and pending items rather than inventing Done results.

Improve existing recurring default account configuration with explicit provider/bank first and one linked active money account second; never offer unassigned or silently select a bank account, preserving prior payments and reminders.

Show a provider/bank selector followed by explicitly chosen linked accounts when editing the recurring default account; prevent a new unassigned default, without guessing financial posting authority or changing historical paid entries.

Preserve recurring transaction provenance when a monthly due is confirmed Paid: the saved ledger row must have sourceType recurring and must not be mislabeled a manually entered transaction; ensure one-time receipt and source validation remain unchanged.

Calculate monthly budget limits and spending for the selected verified money account and for All accounts by summing only explicitly associated account-specific budget allocations; refuse duplicate caps or synthetic linking of shared or unassigned budgets.

Redesign Add Account with separate, required account kind, bank/provider when the selected type is bank, a user-defined name and integer-halalas opening balance; route confirmed creation to the existing verified SQLCipher account writer.

Show the financial institution/bank before its linked account when choosing a verified manual income/expense source and when selecting transfer source/destination accounts; changing the institution must clear the account and never silently use the Home header.
Move the Home All accounts and selected-account picker inside the emerald balance card while preserving the existing verified read-only filter and preventing an implicit money source.
Make the actual Home manual income/expense and transfer editor use the provider/bank then account hierarchy and require that account for a new posting.
Require an explicitly selected verified account before any new income or expense (including reviewed SMS or OCR) is committed; retain historical unassigned entries unchanged.

When a user creates/edits a monthly recurring schedule, choose bank/provider and an active account in that same editor; store the default with the typed recurring row in one SQLCipher transaction, rejecting invalid account IDs atomically.
Fix the pre-existing transfer widget regression to scroll to its now-lower confirmation button before tapping and asserting the invalid amount message.

Persist user-selected account association for each monthly named budget in existing encrypted finance JSON, retaining old shared budgets, and show only verified account-specific monthly caps/spending when switching Home accounts while All sums each budget once.

During creation of an explicitly selected bank account, optionally ask for the user's confirmed last four account/card digits and register it alongside the bank account in one verified SQLCipher transaction so SMS account matching can use bank/provider and suffix evidence.

Fix all four existing Flutter regression test failures without reverting the user-approved account-scoped monthly budgets and two-step bank/account selection. Ensure expectations assert the new, stricter financial routing and centered dropdown behavior.

After 60 seconds of user inactivity in an unlocked foreground Waffra session, show a mandatory biometric-only blocking overlay ABOVE all routes without closing an open form, dropdown or navigation state. On fingerprint/face success reveal exactly the previous screen; cancel/retry must remain locked and login screens are exempt.

Complete M470 account-type/provider linking without replacing original accounts or ledger: store current/savings/investment/deposit/digital wallet subtypes and user-confirmed bank identity in a separately versioned SQLCipher table, read identity before any SMS bank matching, and include the optional identity in V3 encrypted backup and atomic restore. Preserve existing accounts, bank suffixes, financial arithmetic and V2/V3 compatibility.
M470 #7: only after removing every queued SMS from a sender, ask if the user ALSO wants to exclude that sender; no implicit sender-level block from queue removal.
M470 #8: provide the Excluded senders list labelled «المستبعدون» in bank-SMS settings and allow explicit restoration for future messages without restoring intentionally removed past messages.

M470 #9: keep owner-bound encrypted blocked senders, reject their future SMS before analysis and review queue insertion, apply same filter to historical and unknown-financial scans, and reset on verified owner switch.

M470 #10: improve 500-message selection and batch removal without blocking the UI or weakening confirmation; use set lookups, lazily built list, native sealed-filter caching, and 100-item acknowledgements.

M470 #1: fix broken sign-out from every in-app entry point, with a single guarded in-flight action, safe SMS suspension before verified sign-out, and a visible error when the session cannot be safely ended. Preserve all encrypted financial data.

M470 #2: optimize pull-to-refresh across app screens by detecting an unchanged authenticated encrypted source generation and digest after the mandatory verified read, avoiding unnecessary large ledger JSON parse/rebuild; guarded legacy continues full refresh.
